Overview

Clear blue water, white sand and coral reefs, right here in India. Visit the historic Cellular Jail in Port Blair, relax on Radhanagar Beach in Havelock, try scuba diving and explore the natural rock bridge on Neil Island.

Tour highlights

  • Cellular Jail and Light & Sound show
  • Radhanagar Beach, one of Asia's best beaches
  • Scuba diving at Havelock (beginner dive)
  • Elephant Beach snorkelling
  • Natural Bridge and Laxmanpur Beach on Neil Island
  • Private ferry (Makruzz / Green Ocean) transfers
✈ Flights🏨 Resort⛴ Ferry Transfers🤿 Scuba Diving

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Port Blair

Fly from Mumbai to Port Blair. Visit Corbyn's Cove beach and the Cellular Jail, followed by the Light & Sound show.

  • Dinner
Day 2 Port Blair to Havelock

Morning private ferry to Havelock (Swaraj Dweep). Afternoon at Radhanagar Beach for sunset.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 3 Scuba diving & Elephant Beach

Beginner scuba dive with a certified instructor, then a boat to Elephant Beach for snorkelling.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 4 Havelock to Neil Island

Ferry to Neil (Shaheed Dweep). Visit the Natural Bridge, Laxmanpur Beach and Bharatpur Beach.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 5 Neil Island to Port Blair

Ferry back to Port Blair. Visit Chatham Saw Mill or the Samudrika Naval Museum and shop at Aberdeen Bazaar.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 6 Depart for Mumbai

Transfer to Port Blair airport for your flight home.

  • Breakfast

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a permit for Andaman?

Indian citizens do not need a special permit for the islands in this tour. Carry a photo ID for flights and ferries.

I can't swim. Can I still do scuba?

Yes. Beginner dives are done with a trained instructor holding you throughout. You only need to be in good health.
